model_name: ClementP fundus lesion segmentation U-Net SE-ResNeXt50 32x4d

input.preprocessing: Candidate source commit 76840bf2: RGB; crop non-black fundus field using source 5%-of-image-maximum threshold; OpenCV cubic resize longest side to 1024; zero-pad to square; scale 0..255 to 0..1; ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and std [0.229,0.224,0.225]. Source compatibility is recorded but not independently clinically validated.

intended_use: Offline technical research into segmentation of four reported lesion classes. Not clinical decision support, diagnosis, triage, or a general fundus-normality detector.
contraindications: AMD, detachment, tumor, pigmented lesion, vascular-occlusion, or glaucoma inference
Use without a verified local package and patient-separated validation
limitations: CANDIDATE_ONLY: no patient-separated evaluation is recorded
Training data provenance and license compatibility require legal review
No calibration or validated threshold is available
No external validation; target-negative result cannot establish normality
Current dedicated runtime is not ready: torchseg, timm, and einops are absent
Scratch artifact permissions are not immutable production packaging

training_dataset.name: Publisher-reported mixed datasets
training_dataset.provenance: DDR, FGADR, IDRiD, MESSIDOR and RETLES reported by model card

license: MIT artifact tag; training-data provenance and downstream use compatibility unresolved
thresholds: No threshold has been selected. Raw softmax values have no calibrated probability semantics.
postprocessing: No clinical post-processing is approved. Offline technical probe only: force artificial letterbox pixels to background; split each non-background argmax class into 8-connected components with a bounded component count; map half-open model-pixel boxes and centroids through recorded crop/resize/padding to ORIGINAL_IMAGE_NORMALIZED; emit raw_score=null and UNFILTERED_ARGMAX_COMPONENT_NOT_VALIDATED_AS_LESION. No mask artifact is persisted.
